answer_3.quote: We determine the closest option using three complementary methods: cosine similarity (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 4 ), token-F1, and LLM-as-judge (DeepSeek-v3).

answer_4.quote: We evaluated human performance through 12 participants (9 annotators and 3 graduate students) on 15 sets of questions (drawn through stratified random sampling from the 100 question sets to ensure balanced representation across all five question categories and three complexity levels).
answer_4.guideline: Human participants answered the benchmark questions to assess performance.
